Lower Text: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [Rosemon] in its name or the [DATA SQUAD] trait would leave the battle area, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, it doesn't leave.
Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.

[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers suspend, or effects trash cards from under your Tamers, this Digimon may digivolve into a [Vegetation], [Fairy] or [DATA SQUAD] trait Digimon card in the hand with the cost reduced by 1.
